privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy explains what information Eden collects when you use this platform, why we collect it, and how you can control it. It applies to everyone who browses listings, submits an inquiry, creates an account, or lists a property with us.
privacyPage.section1Body: When you create an account, we collect your name and email address. When you submit an inquiry or a viewing request, we collect your name, email, phone number, and any message you include, whether or not you're logged in. When you list a property for sale or rent, we collect the property details you provide along with your contact information and any photos you upload. We also automatically log basic technical information (such as IP address) on form submissions, used only to prevent spam and abuse.
privacyPage.section2Body: We use your information to connect you with the agents who can help you buy, rent, or sell a property; to review and publish property submissions; to respond to inquiries and viewing requests; to manage your account; and to detect and prevent fraud, spam, and abuse of the platform.
privacyPage.section3Body: We share inquiry and submission details with the agent assigned to the relevant property or lead, since that's the point of submitting them. We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We use Supabase to host our database, authentication, and file storage — your data is processed there under their standard hosting terms.
privacyPage.section4Body: We use cookies only for functional purposes: keeping you signed in and remembering your language preference. We do not currently use any third-party advertising or analytics cookies.
privacyPage.section5Body: We keep account, inquiry, and listing data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the service, resolve disputes, and meet legal obligations. You can request deletion at any time — see "Your Rights" below.
privacyPage.section6Body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us using the details below. If you have an account, you can also update most of your information directly from your account settings.
privacyPage.section7Body: We may update this policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we'll update the "last updated" date above.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: These terms govern your use of Eden. By browsing this site, submitting an inquiry, creating an account, or listing a property, you agree to them.
termsPage.section1Body: Eden is a platform that lists properties for sale and rent in Albania and connects buyers, renters, and property owners with real estate agents. Eden is not a party to any sale, rental, or other agreement between you and an agent or property owner — we provide the platform, not the transaction.
termsPage.section2Body: You're responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and for all activity under your account. Provide accurate information when creating an account, and let us know if you believe your account has been compromised.
termsPage.section3Body: If you submit a property to be listed, you confirm that you have the right to list it and that the information and photos you provide are accurate and belong to you (or that you have permission to use them). We review every submission before it goes live, and we may request changes, decline to publish, or remove a listing at our discretion — for example if it appears fraudulent, duplicated, or in breach of these terms.
termsPage.section4Body: When you submit an inquiry or request a viewing, your contact details are shared with the relevant agent so they can respond to you directly. Eden isn't responsible for the conduct of agents or other users you interact with through the platform.
termsPage.section5Body: You may not: submit false, misleading, or duplicate listings; use automated tools to scrape, spam, or abuse the platform's forms; impersonate another person or business; or use the platform for any unlawful purpose.
termsPage.section6Body: The Eden name, branding, and site design belong to us. Content you submit (listing details, photos) remains yours, but by submitting it you grant us a license to display it on the platform for as long as the listing is active.
termsPage.section7Body: Eden is provided "as is." We don't guarantee the accuracy of listings submitted by owners or agents, and we're not liable for the outcome of any transaction, viewing, or communication that happens through the platform.
termsPage.section8Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continuing to use Eden after a change means you accept the updated terms.
